observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor paved courtyard at night, performance or festival occasion with an accompanying band stationed in the background
observation.formation_and_space: line formation entering the space, then forming a circle or semicircular arrangement while performing choreography
observation.posture: upright torso with energetic knee lifts, occasionally bending low or crouching
observation.footwork: high knee lifts, stamping, hopping, and traveling steps on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: holding a small metal shield (kalkan) in one hand and a sword (kılıç) in the other, striking them together, raising them, or extending arms
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip movement; occasional torso dips, lunges, and turns
observation.partnering: none; solo synchronized group dancing with weapon clashing
observation.levels_jumps_turns: jumping kicks, low crouching movements, and turns
observation.costume_and_props: white tall conical hats, patterned vests over shirts, breeches, white socks, shoes, holding swords and small round metal shields
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement on the ground during rapid spins and specific weight transfer nuances due to camera cuts and lighting at night

signature_moments.what: dancers enter the performance space in a single-file line jogging with high knee lifts, carrying swords and shields
dancers in a circle executing high-stepping turns while striking their swords against their shields
dancers drop down into a low crouch while extending shields and swords forward
synchronized jumping kicks and hopping turns with weapons clashing
group kneeling in a tight cluster before springing back up into action
